subject: design/plan-new-routed-demand
statement: Plans remain dense-numbered bucket-1 documents at `<paths.plans>/<feature-slug>/NNN-plan.md` (default `docs/plans/`). The authored Markdown source and generated JSON machine face commit together; merge is approval and freeze. The successor changes the generated schema to `plan/v2` for new plans but preserves the source→fold→verify lifecycle, plan-task identity, coverage matrix, charter contract, sizing policy, overlap handling, and all-or-nothing fog refusal.
